newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's IBV says sold 5.3 pct of Aguas.
newsitem.headline: Spain's IBV says sold 5.3 pct of Aguas.

text.p: Corporacion IBV has sold 5.3 percent, or 2.3 million shares, of Spanish water treatment company Aguas de Barcelona on the international markets, a note from IBV and lead-manager BZW confirmed on Friday.

The note, dated November 21, said BZW had bought the shares and distributed them amongst international institutional investors. The deal had a total value of 11.5 billion pesetas, with a price per share of 5,000 pesetas.
After the deal IBV had a five percent stake in Aguas, the note said.
Shares in Aguas fell sharply on Thursday amid talk that Corporacion IBV was to sell around half of its 10.3 percent stake in the firm.
IBV is a joint-venture between Iberdrola and Banco Bilbao Vizcaya.
